description: Decide what to do next after a result — the branching logic that turns a single outcome into the next lead. Load whenever a step just finished (success, partial, or dead end) and it's unclear where to go: "what now", "I got a shell/creds/a hash", "this didn't work", triaging which of several leads to pursue. This is the decision engine between techniques.
